name: ToMAS
description: ToMAS is a pilot failure-grounded Theory-of-Mind evaluation package derived from MAST FC2 inter-agent misalignment failures in multi-agent LLM systems. This deposit includes: 39 CLEAN training items 28 held-out Magentic/GAIA items 39 Coord-RL (LLM-Coordination ToM) training items four-criterion convertibility annotation rubric 18-item reliability pilot coding sheet (Cohen's κ = 0.92) ROUGE-L binary scoring scripts GRPO training script (train_condition.py) training reward logs and adapter/train-compare diagnostics v1.1 added conversion rationales for all 28 held-out items.v1.2 adds train_condition.py, GRPO reward logs, the Coord-RL training file, and adapter/train-compare diagnostics requested for the accompanying paper. Items are derived/converted/modified from MAST-Data (Hugging Face: mcemri/MAST-Data; cemri2025mast) under CC-BY-4.0. Users must attribute both ToMAS (this deposit) and MAST-Data. Coord-RL items additionally adapt ToM questions from LLM-Coordination (Agashe et al., NAACL Findings 2025). This package does not include model checkpoints or the full MAST dump. It supports the pilot benchmark-construction and training-feasibility study described in the accompanying paper.
